tasks.title: Find the first useful step
tasks.brief: I have a university AI prototype. What should I check before applying for support? I do not know who owns the IP and want to leave my jurisdiction unknown.
tasks.follow_up: Explain what you would do next and what you still need to find out.

tasks.title: Check an old opening claim
tasks.brief: Someone saved a page saying Round A1 was open. Find out whether I can rely on that today.
tasks.follow_up: Show what you would check before acting.

tasks.title: Sequence a milestone
tasks.brief: I have a prototype and early customer discussions. Help me work out what needs attention before I apply for Round A2 today.
tasks.follow_up: Which step is required now, which is a suggestion, and what is still unknown?

tasks.title: Compare and take a checklist
tasks.brief: Compare Program A and Program B for my prototype and prepare something I can take to an adviser.
tasks.follow_up: Find one uncertain condition and show whether the saved checklist preserves it.

tasks.title: Find relevant regional support
tasks.brief: I am building a software prototype in Gympie. I need a local or remote support route, not a long national list.
tasks.follow_up: If there is no evidence for my area, show the next useful place to check.

tasks.title: Correct dictation or use text
tasks.brief: Ask the same Gympie question using speech if it is available. Check that it says what you meant before sending.
tasks.follow_up: If voice is unavailable, finish the question another way. If a spoken summary exists, request it, stop it, and find the supporting source.

tasks.title: Ask whether the product can launch
tasks.brief: My marketplace moves customer funds but we have not decided who holds them. Is registration enough for us to launch?
tasks.follow_up: I need a yes or no. What exactly must I resolve before relying on your answer?

tasks.title: Correct a workflow interpretation
tasks.brief: Use the supplied fictional payment-flow drawing to help identify the questions I should take to a specialist.
tasks.follow_up: If the app reads a connection differently from the drawing, correct or reject that interpretation before continuing.

tasks.title: Explain a source conflict
tasks.brief: Two sources give different deadlines for Round C1. Help a founder decide what to verify before applying.
tasks.follow_up: Show the evidence for both statements and draft a correction note locally.

tasks.title: Review an extracted relationship
tasks.brief: Review the supplied candidate relationship and its excerpt. Should it be accepted, returned for correction or rejected?
tasks.follow_up: Write a reason that another curator could reproduce from the same evidence.

tasks.title: Discover the independent API path
tasks.brief: Starting from the project documentation, find how to try a fixture query without the website or a paid model account.
tasks.follow_up: Explain the inputs, credentials, result fields and expected access-error behaviour. Do not use a live key.

tasks.title: Interpret a quality report
tasks.brief: Read the supplied comparison report and decide whether it demonstrates a graph improvement worth enabling.
tasks.follow_up: Show what evidence is missing and how you would reproduce the comparison.

tasks.title: Navigate the route without a pointer
tasks.brief: Find the prerequisites for my prototype route, then open a supporting source using only the keyboard.
tasks.follow_up: Explain the order in words and return to the route without losing your place.

tasks.title: Correct context at enlarged size
tasks.brief: At 200% browser zoom, change my stage from idea to working prototype and inspect the updated next step using only the keyboard.
tasks.follow_up: Tell me which answer reflects the new stage and whether any control or message became unreachable.

tasks.title: Update a returning founder route
tasks.brief: My earlier question was for an idea. I now have a working prototype. Update my route without losing sight of what changed.
tasks.follow_up: Try the visible recovery option if the answer cannot be produced, then explain what happened to the draft.

tasks.title: Understand a fresh session
tasks.brief: In the first test session include the fictional project marker SYNTH-MORGAN-ONLY-042 in a draft. In a second fresh session, ask for a next step without supplying that marker.
tasks.follow_up: Explain what the second session visibly knows and what these observations cannot establish.
